_doc: Hand-authored source for the Ikebukuro graph. Node xy are anchors in station ENU metres; the builder snaps them to the PLATEAU walkable grid (<= snapR m) and derives z. Edge polylines and stairs/walk mode come from A* over surveyed floor and stair treads. An edge is emitted as verified only when its geometry check passes AND it references an accessFact. See docs/G0-source-audit.md.

floors._note: One continuous public B1 passage level whose surveyed walking height varies 25.9-29.1 m TP; per-node z carries the real height.
No source names this level; it is the open ground where exit stairs end (PLATEAU closure surfaces at the stair tops).

accessFacts.text: 中央通路 (Central Passage) is a public east-west passage outside fare gates, linking the west and east exits.
Exits 27, 34, 35, 36, 37, 41, 42 and 43 connect the public B1 passages east of the JR concourse to street level.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to PLATEAU stair-top closures within 1-7 m

accessFacts.text: JR 中央2改札 opens north and JR 中央1改札 opens south from the Central Passage.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading matched to PLATEAU passage openings (Central Gate 2: 13 m north opening, ~1 m from projected map position; Central Gate 1: south openings, ~6 m)

accessFacts.text: A public passage runs south from the Central Passage, between the JR concourse (east side) and the Seibu store, to the South Passage.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to the PLATEAU passage linking the Central and South Passages

accessFacts.text: 南通路 (South Passage) is a public passage outside fare gates. Its east end continues past the Seibu store, up one short flight and down another, to the corridor serving Exits 39, 40 and 41.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to PLATEAU floors and stair treads (TP 27.6 -> 29.1 -> 25.9 m)

accessFacts.text: Exit 38 (東口（南）/ East Exit South) rises from the South Passage east end beside Seibu; Exit 41 from a north branch of the south-east corridor; Exits 40 and 39 from that corridor, in that order, towards Meiji-dori.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only): order of exit stairs along each passage matched one-to-one to PLATEAU stair-top closures (TP 32.2-32.8 m)

accessFacts.text: A public passage runs north from the Central Passage, along the east side of the JR concourse, to the North Passage (北通路).
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to the PLATEAU passage linking the Central and North Passages

accessFacts.text: 北通路 (North Passage) is a public passage outside fare gates. East of the stairwell to Exit 22 (東口（北）) a short flight leads down to the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to PLATEAU floors and stair treads (TP 28.5 -> 26.2 m)

accessFacts.text: Exit 22 (東口（北）/ East Exit North) rises from the stairwell in the North Passage; Exits 26, 28 and 33 from the south side of the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks, west to east; Exit 32 from its east end, northwards.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only): order of exit stairs along the passage matched one-to-one to PLATEAU stair-top closures (TP 32.1-32.4 m, 5-9 m from the projected map positions)

accessFacts.text: 中央通路 (Central Passage) continues west outside the fare gates, past the Marunouchi Line and Tobu Tojo Line central gates, into the underground hall at 西口 (West Exit).
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to PLATEAU floors (TP 27.9 m)

accessFacts.text: From the West Exit underground hall, public passages lead west towards Exits 7-13 and north between Exits 15 and 17; a passage along the north side links the stairs of Exits 10/11 with Exits 17/18.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only) matched to PLATEAU floors (TP 27.9 m)

accessFacts.text: Exit 15 and Exit 17 rise from the passage running north from the West Exit hall (15 to its west, 17 further north); Exit 18 lies just east of Exit 17; Exits 10 and 11 rise at the west end of the northern passage, 10 to the south of 11.
accessFacts.method: official-map-reading (facts only): exit stairs matched one-to-one to PLATEAU stair-top closures (TP 33.15-33.17 m, within ~5 m of the projected map positions)

summary.text: Routable (desk-verified against the PLATEAU 2023 survey geometry and official 2022/2026 maps; not field-verified; opening hours unknown): slice 1, the B1 Central Passage from the JR Central Gates east to Exits 27/34/35/36/37/42/43; slice 2, the passage along the JR east side to the South Passage east end and the south-east corridor to Exits 38/39/40/41; slice 3, the passage along the JR east side north to the North Passage (Exit 22, 東口（北）) and the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks to Exits 26/28/32/33; slice 4, the Central Passage west to the West Exit (西口) underground hall and its passages to Exits 10/11/15/17/18. The rest of the PLATEAU B1 passage network is explorable but not routable yet. Fare-paid concourses and platforms are not modelled.

ルート案内対象（PLATEAU 2023年計測形状と公式案内図による机上検証。現地未確認、営業時間不明）：第1区画 中央通路（JR中央改札付近）から東側出口27・34・35・36・37・42・43；第2区画 JR東側通路から南通路東端、南東通路の出口38・39・40・41；第3区画 JR東側通路から北通路（出口22・東口（北））、池袋ショッピングパーク間の通路の出口26・28・32・33；第4区画 中央通路（西）から西口地下広場、出口10・11・15・17・18。その他のB1地下通路は探索のみ。改札内・ホームは未モデル化。

assets.derivation: PLATEAU CityGML LOD4.1 -> pipeline/extract_plateau_ubld.py (ENU) -> pipeline/blender_build_glb.py (triangulated, metric UV0); renderer frame (x, z, -y), identity transform

assets/ikebukuro_b1.glb + generated ceiling LED fixtures (GTEki art direction, not surveyed) -> pipeline/blender_bake_lighting.py: second UV set (TEXCOORD_1) and a Cycles diffuse lightmap shipped as assets/ikebukuro_b1_lightmap.webp / _2k.webp (gamma-2.2 encoded, scale in ikebukuro_b1_lit.meta.json)
